name: federal-regulations-mcp-server
description: Search and trace US federal rules across the Federal Register (proposed/final rules, notices, and presidential documents), the eCFR (codified, point-in-time CFR full text and amendment history, locally mirrored), and Regulations.gov (rulemaking dockets, document files, and public comments) via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

regulations_gov_api_key.title: Regulations.gov API key
regulations_gov_api_key.description: api.data.gov key for the Regulations.gov tools (get_docket, find_comments). Free at https://api.data.gov/signup/. The Federal Register and eCFR tools work without it.

clamp_limits.title: Clamp page sizes
clamp_limits.description: Serve a per_page or max_chars above its ceiling at the ceiling, with a notice. Turn off to reject a larger value instead.
